table.name: course
table.purpose: Catalog of courses offered, each with a unique ID and a start date in May; linked to teacher assignments via course_arrange.Course_ID.

Course.name: Course
Course.description: Name of the course/subject offered (e.g. Math, History, Bible, French). One row per course.

Course_ID.name: Course_ID
Course_ID.description: Primary key of the course; unique integer identifier 1-10. Referenced by course_arrange.Course_ID, which assigns teachers/schedules to courses.

Staring_Date.name: Starting_Date
Staring_Date.description: Start date of the course, stored as text in 'D May' format (day + month, no year). Column name is a misspelling of 'Starting_Date'.

table.name: course_arrange
table.purpose: Junction/assignment table linking teachers to courses per grade level: each row records that a given teacher teaches a given course in a given grade. No single column is a primary key; the combination (Course_ID, Grade, Teacher_ID) likely identifies a row, though with only 6 rows this cannot be confirmed.

Course_ID.name: Course_ID
Course_ID.description: Identifier of the course being arranged; references course.Course_ID (e.g. 2 = Math, 4 = History, 10 = Music).

Grade.name: Grade
Grade.description: Grade level (school year) in which the course is taught; small integers 1-7, no join detected, so the exact grade scheme is inferred from the column name and value range only.

Teacher_ID.name: Teacher_ID
Teacher_ID.description: Identifier of the teacher assigned to teach the course; references teacher.Teacher_ID.

table.name: teacher
table.purpose: One row per teacher, storing their name, age, and hometown; teachers are linked to courses via the course_arrange table.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Age of the teacher in years (stored as text but numeric, range 26–45).

Hometown.name: Hometown
Hometown.description: The teacher's hometown; values are administrative areas (urban districts, municipal/county boroughs) around Bolton, England.

Teacher_ID.name: Teacher_ID
Teacher_ID.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each teacher; referenced by course_arrange.Teacher_ID to link teachers to their course assignments.
